WITH mesh_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS side_name,
    sm.facetregistry,
    sm.facetfaces,
    sm.facetverts,
    sm.facetresmm,
    sm.geomdeltamm,
    CAST(sm.facetfaces AS numeric) / (CAST(sm.facetverts AS numeric) * CAST(sm.facetresmm AS numeric) * CAST(sm.facetresmm AS numeric)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    CASE WHEN 
      (CAST(sm.facetfaces AS numeric) / (CAST(sm.facetverts AS numeric) * CAST(sm.facetresmm AS numeric) * CAST(sm.facetresmm AS numeric)) * 1000 > 5.0
       AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0
       AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_high_fidelity
  FROM scanmesh sm
  JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
site_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    site_code,
    side_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(is_high_fidelity) AS high_fidelity_count,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(is_high_fidelity) AS numeric) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    ROUND(AVG(mcr), 4) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    ROUND(AVG(facetresmm), 4) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    ROUND(AVG(geomdeltamm), 4) AS avg_geom_accuracy
  FROM mesh_data
  GROUP BY site_code, side_name
),
mesh_quality AS (
  SELECT 
    site_code,
    side_name,
    total_mesh_count,
    high_fidelity_count,
    high_fidelity_proportion,
    avg_complexity_ratio,
    avg_resolution_mm,
    avg_geom_accuracy,
    CASE WHEN MAX(high_fidelity_flag) > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' ELSE 'Standard Mesh Quality' END AS mesh_quality
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      site_code,
      side_name,
      total_mesh_count,
      high_fidelity_count,
      high_fidelity_proportion,
      avg_complexity_ratio,
      avg_resolution_mm,
      avg_geom_accuracy,
      MAX(is_high_fidelity) AS high_fidelity_flag
    FROM mesh_data
    GROUP BY site_code, side_name, total_mesh_count, high_fidelity_count, high_fidelity_proportion, avg_complexity_ratio, avg_resolution_mm, avg_geom_accuracy
  ) sub
)
SELECT 
  site_code,
  side_name,
  total_mesh_count,
  high_fidelity_count,
  high_fidelity_proportion,
  avg_complexity_ratio,
  avg_resolution_mm,
  avg_geom_accuracy,
  mesh_quality
FROM mesh_quality
ORDER BY mesh_quality DESC;
